description: Split hero shell reused for the MCP-use-cases family: same left-text/right-media geometry as hero.product, but the right media is a use-case-specific illustration (a logo grid on the index, a per-slug mock on detail pages) via a children render slot rather than a fixed set of mocks.
scope: Present on mcp-index and all 8 mcp-detail routes (9 route occurrences).
